subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: What public contract should OpenClaw expose, if any, for disabling built-in skill source roots such as `agents-skills-personal`?
rationale: The request is valid from source inspection, but any fix adds `skills.load` config surface and changes built-in source semantics, which repository policy treats as a maintainer product/API decision.

options.title: Typed Source Disable List
options.body: Add a narrow `skills.load.disableSources`-style list with explicit allowed source ids and make discovery, watchers, docs, and status respect it.

options.title: Personal-Source Toggle Only
options.body: Expose only a boolean for the personal `.agents/skills` source, minimizing scope but leaving project-source and future source opt-outs unresolved.

options.title: Decline Source Opt-Out
options.body: Keep built-in source scanning always on and direct users to prompt limits and per-skill disables, accepting that source conflicts and watcher overhead remain.

recommendation.title: Typed Source Disable List
recommendation.body: Add a narrow `skills.load.disableSources`-style list with explicit allowed source ids and make discovery, watchers, docs, and status respect it.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main ownership signal is on the skills loader, watcher, and config schema surface where the decision would be implemented.
